title: Notification bug
body: This app is extremely aesthetic and a pleasure to use , I was having issues with receiving notifications so I reached out the the developer and they were incredibly kind and and patient with me while they worked on a solution to resolve my issue , can not rate this app or its developer highly enough , if you haven’t already please go and check out some of their other apps if you are a fan of this one 💕
author: Grimesy💕
